title: Asking yes or no
label: ch:gu-asking-yes-or-no
canDo: I can ask a question that is answered yes or no, with śũ, ke nahī̃ or kharũ, answer it, and say whose things are whose and what someone likes or has.

payoff.summary: Carry a short exchange of yes-or-no questions about likes, family and plans, and answer one with a negative.
